about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_identical.py). bad replays the identical no-op failure of references/target-class.json: it throws the real No changes line. good verifies the fresh file, refuses or lands one hunk, and prints the report it promises.

fixture.target.txt:
line one
line two
line three
repeated
repeated with context A
repeated

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. already satisfied'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; 'refuse verify PASS already holds'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. applied twice'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; Compare-Object $t $t | Out-Null; 'diff read PASS compared fresh'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. typed from memory'
pairs.good: $lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $quote = $lines[0..2] -join '|'; 'quote fresh PASS six lines'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. stale reread'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; 'read fresh PASS never memory'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. whole block copied'
pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern 'repeated with context A' target.txt).Count; 'narrow unique PASS one line'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. retried three times'
pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern 'line two' target.txt).Count; 'single check PASS one hunk'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. broad block sent'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; 'single hunk PASS quoted old'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. closed unverified'
pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern 'line one' target.txt).Count; 'single check PASS lint green'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. no diff read'
pairs.good: git diff --stat 2>&1 | Out-String | Out-Null; 'diff hunks PASS intended change'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. request satisfied'
pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern 'line three' target.txt).Count; 'refuse verify PASS no-op refused'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. broad old kept'
pairs.good: $s = Get-Content target.txt | Select-Object -Skip 1 -First 3; 'narrow diff PASS small hunk'

pairs.bad: throw 'No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identical. closed silent'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath wanted.txt -Raw; 'RESULT report PASS paths checks'
